subject.title: fix(voice-call): ngrok tunnels no longer survive cleanup

question: Should the two open ngrok timeout-lifecycle changes be consolidated into one implementation before merge, or may they land separately after an explicit composition review?
rationale: The supplied PR descriptions establish overlapping edits to the same startup-timeout ownership path, but the unavailable read-only checkout prevents a source-and-history comparison sufficient to resolve their interaction automatically.

options.title: Consolidate lifecycle ownership
options.body: Rebase and combine the timer, closed-state, and bounded-reaping behavior into one reviewed path with focused coverage for both failure modes.

options.title: Land separately after composition proof
options.body: Keep the PRs separate only after a maintainer verifies their merged result has one intentional timeout and child-ownership contract.

recommendation.title: Consolidate lifecycle ownership
recommendation.body: Rebase and combine the timer, closed-state, and bounded-reaping behavior into one reviewed path with focused coverage for both failure modes.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the proposed bounded-reaping implementation and can help reconcile it with the adjacent timeout work; current-main feature ownership could not be traced.
